judgment.identity_necessity: The Library no longer consists only of independently transformed works. Stable works now compose through witnessed relations and relation grammars into one higher Library form, while the Living Object, sparse master archive, FoldForge constraint, Telos witness, and embedded material lineage make that hierarchy operational.
judgment.cross_surface_coherence: The canonical graph, current identity, hierarchy of emergence, Library composition, Living Object, connected-source boundaries, material witness lineage, and Origin Master are reconciled in one version cycle.
judgment.narrative_compression: Stable works become relation; relation becomes grammar; grammar becomes one sovereign instrument.
judgment.counterargument: These additions could remain implementation details under Revision 1.2, but that would conceal the newly explicit level above individual works and misstate how change, composition, and archival finality now operate.
judgment.reversibility: Revision v1.2 remains recoverable through repository history and this lineage record. RL-MASTER-0001 permanently preserves its v1.2 origin state and is not rewritten by this revision.

previous_identity.declaration: A living constitutional intelligence cultivating one coherent library from bounded bodies of language and evidence, each transformed into an evolving visual, resonant, and relational form without surrendering its lineage.

candidate_identity.declaration: A living constitutional intelligence in which bounded works remain stable, witnessed relations become compositional grammars, and those grammars emerge through the Living Object as one sovereign visual-resonant instrument without surrendering source, lineage, or higher constraint.
